fact: At about 20:00 on March 28, 2016, the defendant XXX found a VIVOX5 mobile phone of the victim XXX, beside the road of the football field in XXX Village, XXX District of the city. From 21:00 on March 28, 2016, the defendant secretly stole 3723 yuan from the victim XXX through the small-amount password-free payment function of Alipay. After the incident, the family of the defendant XXX has compensated the victim for all losses and obtained forgiveness.

elements.behavior: Found the victim's mobile phone and used the Alipay small-amount password-free payment function to steal 3,723 yuan.
elements.consequence: The victim suffered an economic loss of 3,723 yuan.
elements.fact: The defendant committed theft by taking the victim's mobile phone and illegally withdrawing 3,723 yuan through Alipay. The family of the defendant compensated the victim's losses in full and obtained forgiveness, which can be considered as a mitigating circumstance for sentencing.
